title: Field Kit Box with Hinge and Spring Latch
description: Pocket-size hinged box (80 x 54 x 30 mm) with a removable steel-free hinge pin and a flexure snap-latch that clicks shut and opens with a thumb press. Prints open-side-up with no supports.
use: Trail kit for fish hooks/lures, first-aid strips, geocaching swag, coins, SD cards or beads. Latch keeps the lid closed in a pack.
material: PETG, 0.2 mm layers, 4 perimeters. Latch arm needs layers running along its length (print as oriented). Pin: PETG or a 4 mm steel-free rod/filament offcut.

problem_solved: Small trail items rattle loose or spill from pockets; most printed boxes either need fiddly hinges or rely on friction lids. This one has a real hinge and a positive click-latch you can operate one-handed with gloves.
mechanism: Hinge: 3 knuckles on a 4 mm pin (press-fit in base knuckles, free in lid). Latch: cantilever arm on lid front with a rectangular window that hooks under a chamfered lip on the base; press the arm tip outward to release.
tolerances: Pin 2.0 mm radius in base holes 2.1 (0.1 press) and lid hole 2.35 (0.35 free); knuckle gaps 1.0 mm; lid/base rim gap 0.3 mm; latch travel 0.7 mm before catch; arm to base face 0.4 mm.
assembly: 1. Print base, lid (printed roof-down) and pin.
2. Close lid onto base with knuckles interleaved.
3. Slide the pin through all three knuckles from the left; a drop of glue or tape on the head keeps it in.
4. Press lid down until the latch clicks.
fit_notes: Latch arm is the wear part - print a spare. Hinge pin is small: keep from toddlers.
